scope: reviewer Chat Store native receipt diagnostic only
cause: storedSessionShape classified matrx.org.active as present only when it was a string. The canonical active-org writer persists an object with id and name, and the resolver reads its id, so a valid selected organization was falsely reported absent.

contract.reader: src/lib/org/active-org.ts readStoredSelection requires a nonempty string id
contract.siblings: Other browser drivers, including settings-native-auth-driver.mjs, read matrx.org.active.id. No sibling source change was needed in this narrow lane.

red_green.red: node --test tests/browser/reviewer-chat-storage-shape.test.mjs failed: persisted object selection false !== true against the original string-only classifier
red_green.green: The same command passed 3 tests after repair; in-memory constant-true, constant-false, and string-only mutants were rejected by the guard.
red_green.additional_checks: Biome formatted the three changed source/test files; node --check on the browser driver and git diff --check passed.

change: The diagnostic now summarizes an object with a nonblank string id. The browser storage expression uses the same tested function, records only booleans, and refuses a PASS if the selected organization is not persisted in that shape.
privacy: The receipt contains only presence booleans; no organization id/name, token, or profile value is serialized by this diagnostic.
limitation: No browser or published Store artifact was exercised in this source-only lane. The previous member receipt remains historically false and must not be relabeled; root owns a fresh native run and independent review.
